citations.narrative:
There were 4 stainless steel self-feeders that contained multiple pieces of dog food that were not sufficient for
consumption. The pieces of dry dog food had a fuzzy, light grey-light green material growing on them, which appeared to
be mold. Some pieces of food were also caked onto the bottom/sides of the feeder. The enclosures these feeders were
attached to house a total of 6 dogs. Having food contaminated by mold in the feeders is problematic in case a dog was to
ingest the food, which could cause intestinal upset or other illness. Additionally, non-consumable food could increase the
potential for attracting pests and causing unpleasant odors in the kennel. It is unclear when the feeders were last cleaned
and sanitized. The licensee disposed of the moldy food at the time of the inspection. Correct by ensuring food fed to the
dogs is uncontaminated, wholesome, and palatable. Correct by: August 26, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
